subject: c-cont
title: C.CONT.------C.ACT.
description: Diagram in AE(PD)-12 (Aspect Essence / Perception Dynamics, Level One), on the page where Braxton argues that the motivating factor for sixties activism 'had not so much to do with the dynamics of any one focus, but rather had to do with a greater cosmic awareness (and concern) for human rights' — and that 'however different each person's physical universe slant — in terms of so-called race or ideology — the basic affinity that solidified the resurgence of alternative functionalism in the sixties could be reduced to how people related to the concept of human rights.' (C)C-CONT (composite continuance) is crossed with C-ACT (composite activism): the question is what composite continuance produces when crossed with the composite activism that the sixties represented. TR (transformation) branches from the main line and carries SOC-RT (social reality) and INFO-DY (information dynamics). INFO-DY leads to EXT-INFO-B, which carries (R)TM (the reality of terminology—or terms of a definition) and, on a *dashed* line, PR-TRS, from which EXT-F (extended functionalism) branches. INFO-DY also leads to POST (postulation), which carries AF-DY (affinity dynamics) on a *dashed* line; AFI (affinity insight) branches from AF-DY. The dotted lines amplify some aspect of the main concept they are connected to.
